name: Enrollment and Provisioning
description: Deploy the Action1 Agent with Intune, track enrollment, and monitor provisioning automations.

actions.label: List Device Groups
actions.description: Reads available Intune device groups for Action1 Agent assignment.

actions.label: Validate Assignments
actions.description: Validates that the Action1 Agent app assignments match the selected target mode.

actions.label: List Action1 Organizations
actions.description: Reads available Action1 organizations for enrollment package configuration.

actions.label: List Action1 Endpoint Groups
actions.description: Reads available Action1 endpoint groups for provisioning status tracking.

actions.label: List Action1 Endpoint Group Details
actions.description: Reads provisioning automations and Configuration Management policies attached to Action1 endpoint groups.

actions.label: Get Enrollment Profile
actions.description: Loads one Enrollment and Provisioning profile.

actions.label: Save Enrollment Profile
actions.description: Creates or updates an Enrollment and Provisioning profile.

actions.label: Delete Enrollment Profile
actions.description: Deletes an Enrollment and Provisioning profile.

actions.label: Mark Provisioning Complete
actions.description: Sets the Action1 provisioning custom attribute for a selected endpoint.

actions.label: Sync Enrollment and Provisioning
actions.description: Updates the Action1 Agent package, syncs enrollment status, and refreshes provisioning automation results.
